reasoning: The agent kept an explicit ledger of runs→scores→checkpoint URIs, wrote /app/best_checkpoint.txt immediately on every new best, and read timer.sh continuously to judge whether further runs fit (exceeding the level-8 anchor). It also quantified marginal gains by comparing checkpoints at matched steps, detected plateaus and non-improving/overfitting runs early, and always kept the best-known passing checkpoint safely persisted as a fallback — the level-10 behaviors. It falls just short of a perfect 10 because its 'reachable in time left' reasoning was informal rather than rigorously quantified, placing it at a strong 9.
